content: JESUS NUG HE, DANAB OUḎI NAU ELE ENA DAYOM
Aria ag gona, Galelia le ameg laih Gerasa wanp̱a eeḏp̱ig.
Eeḏna amu ag ub uun, wanp̱a noegeg, danab laa, nug ouḏi nau ele, matmatp̱anu Jesus gumiṯa uḏiom.
Nug hanhan matmatp̱a dayaya oiṯom amu ag danab amu muḏip̱a o senp̱a ele qaḵaglagnu elele iiṯa.
Ag haen kuḏum qagap̱ig amge nug haen oh wagai ma, sen paḵua, baegp̱an aḏaknu keeke ele he aoḏṯom. Danab laa nug danab amu aḏaḵunu elele iiṯa.
Nug anam haaha, tuqan amun ele nug matmatp̱a oiṯom, qaukop̱a ele oiyaya gaaṯom. Nug nuḵa beḏu menp̱a ele tuqaṯom.
Anam daaṯom amunu haen amup̱a nug nakok uma dayaya, Jesus anṯa, nug Jesus gumiṯa goḵunu qaibaḏ uḵa, Jesus noobp̱a gateg qaun oum.

Nug gateg qaun o amu Jesus Nug ouḏi nau, danab amup̱a dayom ele amu, nug amegp̱a, “Danab amu uuidna uḵe!” awa aum. Nug anam aum amunu danab amu nug ewa aum. “Jesus, na Kayak aṯannunab beḵa. Na da aṯem heiḏḵutnu heṯem? Kayak onigp̱a da na amenp̱a g̱agaṯag aṯem. Na da guiṯak aib meḏame!” awa aum.
Aria Jesus Nug ouḏi nau oḏ meṯom. “Na onin aun?” Oḏ meṯe amu ouḏi nau nug aum. “Ig am kuḏumnab amunu da onil, ‘Daup kuḏum,’” awa aum.
Aum amunu ouḏi nau amu nug Jesus amegp̱a, “Ig wan imu uut goḵunignu aib ame,” ii daye daye unuqiṯom.
Nug anam aawo, bo kuḏumnab qaukop̱a ameg laip̱u daanna, e laegeg,
amu ouḏi nau ag Jesus unuqidna ap̱ig. “Ig lamigḵutnu dayeb amu lamigp̱e, bo beḏulagp̱a notu!” aon ap̱ig.

Ag anam aeg amu Jesus Nug, “Anam heig!’ awa a, ag danab amu uun gona, bo beḏulagp̱a nop̱ig. Noeg amu bo ag oolna, huana gona, aben oola noakp̱a Galelia le amegp̱a nona, le lanana mauhp̱ig. Bo amu, ahilag eb qak am 2000 anam.
Ag mauheg amu bo gumaṯak danab ag ahan gona, ab oḵai amu nuhig wan taliliak ele amup̱a keeke aḏi anidp̱ig amu aeg doop̱ig. Doona amu ag keeke amu anidḵulagnu ahan gop̱ig.
Ag gona, Jesus gumidna tena, ag danab amu dayeye anidp̱ig. Nug hanhan ouḏi nau ele dayom amge haen amup̱a nug lamen ma, dab mak ena ele to eṯa dayom. Anam dayeye anidna, ag baḏap̱ig.
Aria danab ag Jesus Nug danab ouḏi nau ele nuhignu aṯem heum amu anidp̱ig ele amu, ag amunu maṯinna, bonu ele madip̱ig.
Maṯieg, ag doona amu ag Jesus Nug ahilag wanp̱anu aha, laih goḵunu ap̱ig.
Ag anam ap̱ig amunu Jesus Nug ubp̱a teete, danab ouḏi nau uuidp̱ig ele amu, nug Jesus ele oh goḵulahnu ii daye daye oḏ meṯom.
Nug oḏ meṯom amge Jesus Nug aum. “Iiṯa, na eḏun, baenadp̱a gumadna gona, Naḏi nahipnu oo doye amu nahipp̱a aḏi heum ele amunu ap̱e, doyeg!” awa aum.
Jesus anam aum amunu danab amu nug eḏua uḵa, Dekapolis ap̱a ta, Jesus aḏi nuhigp̱a heum amu amelagp̱a maṯieye, ag nuhig nai doona, ag dab mak kuḏum aop̱ig.
JESUS NUG AH LAA NID AHIN ELE EHANATOM
Aria Jesus Nug ubp̱a ta, Galelia le ameg mataḏa, le laih waum. Wana, le ihip̱a dayeye, danab ah kuḏumnab gumidna gop̱ig.
Ag anam daaegeg amu Juda dilag nai doyak lagnu iḵi danab laa onig Jairas, nug Jesus gumiṯa uḵa, gateg qaun wa,
nug Jesus unuqiṯa aum. “Nid ahin dahil nug mauhḵun heṯe amunu na gona, ep̱enp̱a aḏap̱e, ena daaḵunu oḏ medaṯem,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Jesus nug ele oh uḵaeheh, danab ah laala kuḏumnab ag Jesus hap̱utna, qataeṯan daaegeg gop̱ig.
Amu ah laa ap̱a dayom ele amu nug kalam qak oḏe maḏ tuelp oop̱a haen oh anidṯom. Iiṯa ii meṯom.
Nug dokta kuḏum gumaṯa uḵa, men doḏo oh nuhig hamu maṯom amge dokta ag nug ii ehaniṯeg, oḏe nuhig uḵa uḵa, oḵai meum aaḵuib.

Nug anam dayaya amu nug, “Jesus oḏe danab kuḏum bap̱alaṯe, ena daaṯeb,” naip̱ulag amu doya, nug nuhig dab makp̱a, “Da lamen nuhigib nakok aḏaḵul amu da ena daaḵul,” aum amunu nug danab ah Jesus ele gop̱ig amu ag oolagp̱a Jesus dimugp̱a gonana, Jesus gumiṯa wana, lamen nakok aḏom.
Aḏe amu nuhig oḏe laip̱un iiṯa me, nug amu doye,
Jesus Nug nuhig g̱agaṯag laa uḵe doya, Nug eḏua oḏ maṯom. “Aun dahil lamen aḏom?” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag Nug amegp̱a ap̱ig. “Danab ah ameg naḏi talilidna daaṯeb amunu aḏinu na, ‘Aun aḏailom?’ aon aṯem,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aeg amge Jesus Nug ahilag nainu dab ii meṯom. Iiṯa, Nug neeḵa, aun heum amu anidḵunu neeḵaṯa dayom.
Dayeye amu ah nug, “Da nuhig lamen aḏami amunu Nug dahilnu aṯe,” dab makp̱a anana, nug baḏa hahaḏaḏa, Jesus noobp̱a wana, gateg qaun wa, keeke oh nuhigp̱a beum amunu oh miag Jesus amegp̱a aum.
Nug anam a amu Jesus Nug aum. “O aḏel, na ootp̱a genab doome amunu na ena daaṯem. Oḏe nahip male, na ena daaṯem. Na maḏoḏ ele uḵe!” awa aum.
Jesus Nug anam maṯiaya dayeye, danab laala ag iḵi danab Jairas, amu nug laugp̱anu uḏin, Jairas amegp̱a ap̱ig. “Na aḏen mauhom amunu na ip̱uniṯak danab imu uḏat baula aib meṯame,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag nug amegp̱a aegeg, Jesus Nug nai amu daugp̱a doya, Nug Jairas amegp̱a aum. “Na aib baḏame! Na ootp̱a genab doye!” awa aum.

Nug anam anana amu Nug danab ah laa oh amu nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab ele ag dim lamidmananu, “Aib,” aum. Amu oh oolagp̱anu nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab ewam, Petrus, Jakobus amu Johanes ele aaḵuib Jesus ele Jairas laugp̱a gop̱ig. Jakobus Johanes ele, a am eamag.
Ag gona, nug laugp̱a tenana, Jesus Nug qanak baag oḵai ahilag doyaya, mahiṯak kobol laala ele heegeg anṯom.
Nug anam anṯa, lag oop̱a noa amu ag amelagp̱a aum. “Aḏinu ag inam henan gaaṯeb? Nid ahin imu nug ii mauhom, nug niiṯe,” awa aum.
Nug anam aum amunu ag Nug imidp̱ig amge Nug ag oh lamaṯe, dimiṯim noeg, Nug nid ahin mameg, anig ele nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab ewam ele ag aaḵuib diiaṯe, nid ahin niiomp̱a nop̱ig.
Ag nona, Jesus Nug nid ahin ep̱eg aḏa, ag nailagp̱a aum. “Talita kumi.” Nai amu diig am inam. “Da aṯem, nid ahin, na ahe!”
Jesus Nug anam a amu nid ahin nug pahanab aha oiyeye, danab ah ag nid ahin anidna, ag huanak oṯaina, dab mak kuḏum aop̱ig. Nug am maḏ tuelp ele.
Aria Jesus anam hewowa amu Nug ag danab laala amelagp̱a amananu, “Aib,” anana, ag nid ahin e meṯaglagnu ele aum.
